items.desc:
A flaw was found in ansible-core's ansible.builtin.git module. The module
invokes git (ls-remote, clone, fetch) with the repository URL as a positional
argument and without a "--" separator, so a repository URL that begins with a
dash is interpreted by git as a command-line option. A caller that passes an
attacker-controlled repository URL to the module can trigger argument
injection (for example --upload-pack/--exec), resulting in arbitrary command
execution on the host running the module.

Attackers can use a path-shaped display name ../databases/proof.txt combined with a controlled content stream to write to arbitrary locations within the receiving application's private sandbox under its UID, achieving file overwrite without user interaction.

items.desc:
During ABI bootstrap, the bootstrap node's approve-csr.service approves and signs every CSR without identity validation.

An attacker on the install network can retrieve the unauthenticated Ignition file (ports 22623/22624), extract a limited kubeconfig, submit a CSR for CN=system:admin, receive the signed certificate, and gain full cluster-admin access.

Exploitable only during the narrow bootstrap window.

items.title: A flaw was found in the rrule validation of schedules in automation controller. Several non-anchored regular expressions with…
items.ai: CVSS 4.3（中危）。暂无公开 POC，按常规补丁窗口安排。 影响版本：详见公告。
items.desc: A flaw was found in the rrule validation of schedules in automation controller. Several non-anchored regular expressions with lazy wildcard prefixes are applied to the user-supplied rrule value; when the expected DTSTART/RRULE tokens are absent, validation time grows quadratically with the length of the value. An authenticated user can submit a large token-free rrule through the REST API, including the schedule preview endpoint, which requires no resource-level permissions; validation runs synchronously in the API web worker, so a single such request occupies a worker for an extended time and repeated requests can exhaust the web worker pool, denying access to the API and web UI while the attack is sustained. The impact is limited to availability.

items.title: SuperTokens Core is an open source authentication server. Prior to 11.3.6, 11.4.6, and 12.0.8, app-specific management requests…

items.desc: SuperTokens Core is an open source authentication server. Prior to 11.3.6, 11.4.6, and 12.0.8, app-specific management requests using an unknown tenant path and an older supported cdi-version can bypass API-key and public-tenant enforcement. In src/main/java/io/supertokens/webserver/WebserverAPI.java, checkIPAccess and assertThatAPIKeyCheckPasses suppress TenantOrAppNotFoundException, while the later app-specific handler resolves app/public storage and the public-tenant guard applies only to CDI versions 5.0 and later. An unauthenticated caller able to reach the Core endpoint can therefore use PUT /ghosttenant/recipe/role and GET /ghosttenant/recipe/roles to create and enumerate application roles without a valid API key. This issue is fixed in versions 11.3.6, 11.4.6, and 12.0.8.

items.desc: compose-lint is a Docker Compose security linter that identifies dangerous misconfigurations before deployment. From 0.32.0 until 0.33.0, compose-lint's incomplete remediation for .env secret disclosure checks the 20,000-finding limit before replacing resolved values with their variable references. A pull request can combine a secret-referencing image field with aliased content that produces more than 20,000 findings, causing the early-stop path to emit already graded findings with the resolved secret value in text, JSON, SARIF, and Code Scanning output. Exploitation requires a workflow that writes secrets into the sibling .env and lints untrusted changes, and the run exits 2 unless --allow-partial-coverage is used. This issue is fixed in version 0.33.0.

From 0.2.0 until 0.25.0, compose-lint follows a project-controlled symbolic link used as the Compose file outside the project. From 0.22.0 until 0.32.0, compose-lint substitutes values from a sibling .env file into image fields and quotes the resolved value in CL-0004 and CL-0019 finding messages and fix text. In a workflow that writes secrets into that file and then lints untrusted pull-request content, an attacker can reference a secret variable so its whole value reaches the job log, JSON output, SARIF artifacts, and Code Scanning alerts. Fork pull requests normally lack secrets, so exploitation requires a secret-bearing workflow such as pull_request_target, same-repository branches, or a retained .env on a self-hosted runner, and the pass or fail result is unchanged. This issue is fixed in version 0.32.0.

items.desc: compose-lint is a Docker Compose security linter that identifies dangerous misconfigurations before deployment. From 0.9.0 until 0.18.0, compose-lint's YAML parser recognizes lone carriage returns and Unicode line separators U+0085, U+2028, and U+2029 as line breaks while fix position conversion counts only newline characters. A pull request can place one of these separators in a quoted value so fix --apply shifts each later edit and deletes the line after the selected target, including an unselected network or other security setting. The resulting Compose file can remain valid, post-edit checks can pass, and the command can report a successful fix even though the dry-run diff was the only place showing the extra deletion. This issue is fixed in version 0.18.0.

items.desc: Thor Vector Graphics (ThorVG) is a production-ready vector graphics engine. Prior to 1.1.2, the bundled jpgd JPEG decoder accepts duplicate component selectors in an SOS scan header, causing each duplicate to increase m_blocks_per_mcu without checking the buffers sized from the frame components. A crafted grayscale JPEG can repeat its component in the SOS header, causing decode paths in src/loaders/jpg/tvgJpgd.cpp to write beyond heap buffers sized for one component. The issue is reachable through direct JPEG decoding and through JPEG images embedded in Lottie content, and confirmed impact is memory corruption followed by a process crash. This issue is fixed in version 1.1.2.

In streams mode, the management HTTP API is exposed on `0.0.0.0:4195`, but authentication is disabled by default and there is no authentication gate protecting the stream CRUD routes. items.desc: Eclipse Langium versions 3.2.0 through 4.4.0 contain an inefficient algorithmic complexity issue (CWE-407) in the opt-in IndentationAwareTokenBuilder and IndentationAwareLexer. When producing DEDENT tokens, the token builder recomputes line numbers by re-scanning the entire preceding document text. A document whose indentation changes on most lines then takes quadratic time to tokenize. Because tokenization is synchronous, a crafted document of a few hundred kilobytes can block the Node.js event loop for tens of seconds. That causes a DoS for every user served by the same process. Languages built with the DefaultLexer and DefaultTokenBuilder are unaffected.

This issue is fixed in version 2.0.0rc7.

items.title: In Eclipse Langium versions 3.0.0 and later, the langium-sprotty package does not HTML-escape diagnostic messages before…
items.ai: 暂无 CVSS 评分。暂无公开 POC，按常规补丁窗口安排。 影响版本：详见公告。
items.desc: In Eclipse Langium versions 3.0.0 and later, the langium-sprotty package does not HTML-escape diagnostic messages before rendering them in the default hover popup provided by `addHoverPopupHandler`. If a Langium grammar allows cross-reference text to contain HTML markup (such as through a STRING terminal), an unresolved cross-reference produces a diagnostic message that includes the literal ref text. When a Sprotty diagram is opened for a malicious source file under these conditions, and a user hovers over the corresponding error marker, attacker-controlled JavaScript can execute in the browser or webview.

items.title: A SQL injection vulnerability exists in a database migration script in flowintel.  The migration process reads stored connector…
items.ai: 暂无 CVSS 评分。暂无公开 POC，按常规补丁窗口安排。 影响版本：详见公告。
items.desc:
A SQL injection vulnerability exists in a database migration script in flowintel.

The migration process reads stored connector identifier values from the database and interpolates them directly into SQL statements without parameterization. An attacker who has previously written a malicious identifier value into the affected tables can cause arbitrary SQL execution when the migration is subsequently run during an application upgrade.

- Requires prior write access to the database to plant a malicious identifier value
- Triggered automatically during a migration or upgrade operation
- Can result in unauthorized data disclosure, modification, or deletion

Affected versions: flowintel prior to 4.0.0

items.title: http.cookiejar.CookieJar deleted a stored cookie when a response carried an already expired Set-Cookie header for it, using the…
items.ai: 暂无 CVSS 评分。暂无公开 POC，按常规补丁窗口安排。 影响版本：详见公告。
items.desc:
http.cookiejar.CookieJar deleted a stored cookie when a response carried an
already expired Set-Cookie header for it, using the Domain and Path
attributes from the header without consulting the cookie policy. A server
could therefore delete cookies belonging to other domains from a shared
cookie jar, such as the one used by urllib's HTTPCookieProcessor. The fix
consults the cookie policy before an expired cookie may delete an existing
one, as required by RFC 6265 section 5.3.
